name: Senpai
source:
Main character admires his senpai who is graduating in a few days. Will he have the time to confess his feelings or look for other girls instead? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角仰慕即將在幾天後畢業的學姊。他還有時間向她告白嗎？還是應該轉而尋找其他女孩？

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]］
